reason: The plan hits exactly 12 numbered steps and satisfies every hard requirement (rehearsal on non-production data, post-cutover row-count/checksum verification, stakeholder communication, and a full backup immediately preceding the maintenance-window steps that quiesce/modify production), while also being realistic and actionable with sizing, replication, go/no-go, and monitoring details; the only minor gap is that rollback handling for writes made to the new instance between cutover and a delayed rollback decision is left somewhat vague.
